Bill.BriefDescription: Offering a tricare supplemental insurance policy to certain public employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the public employees' benefits board offering atricare supplemental insurance policy to employees who are eligible forthis policy, but not eligible for medicare parts A and B; and adding anew section to chapter 41.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any other provisions of this chapter or rulesor procedures adopted by the authority under this chapter, theauthority may make available a tricare supplemental insurance policy,32 C.F.R. Sec. 199.17 (2004), to employees who are eligible. Thissupplemental policy may be offered as one of the board's healthcoverage options. Employee selection of this supplemental policy isexclusive of selecting any other medical coverage offered through theboard. If offered by the board, this supplemental policy shall be madeavailable to employees, and retired or disabled employees, eligible forcoverage available under the authority, but not eligible for medicareparts A and B. p. 1 SB 5391 (2) The administrator may adopt rules to carry out the purposes ofthis section.
